uiScale.title: Display size
uiScale.description: Text and controls in the app and on the Android widget. Applies to your account on all devices.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Plan, capture and coordinate appointments as a team.
login.cardHint: Sign in with your email address and password.

password.forgotHint: Enter your email address. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
password.forgotSent: If an account with this address exists, an email is on its way. Please also check your spam folder.
password.invalidHint: Request a new link or contact your administrator.

home.title: Overview
home.subtitle: Appointments, daily schedule and team at a glance.
home.noTenantForAppointments: You need a tenant membership to view appointments.
home.calendarHint: 14-day view. Pick a day to see appointments on the left.
home.markCompletedFailed: Could not mark appointment as done
home.deleteConfirm: Delete appointment “{title}”? You can restore it from the trash.
home.duplicateHint: Copy with the same time and details – a new appointment is created only when you save.
home.editHint: Adjust date, contact, and assignments, then save.
home.captureHintVoice: Capture by voice or text, assign {teacher}{resource}, then save.
home.captureHintText: Capture by text, assign {teacher}{resource}, then save.

quickCapture.noTenantDescription: You need an active tenant membership to create real appointments.
quickCapture.conflictFreeSlots: {teacher} is still free on this day – pick a time:
quickCapture.conflictNoSlots: {teacher} has no suitable free time left on this day.
quickCapture.newCustomerInfo: When saving, the passenger is created as a customer if they don't exist yet.
quickCapture.dictationInfo: Or just dictate – the voice assistant fills in the fields.
quickCapture.textPlaceholder: e.g. Tomorrow 2 pm with Luis and {teacher} Martin
quickCapture.assistantHintsAria: About the voice assistant and text analysis
quickCapture.exampleVoice: Example: “tomorrow flight Martin, passenger Alexandra, phone +49 333 6788. Fertig.”
quickCapture.exampleText: Example: “tomorrow flight Martin, passenger Alexandra, phone +49 333 6788.”
quickCapture.stopHint: Say “Fertig”, “Speichern” or “OK” at the end to stop recording.
quickCapture.priorityHint: Without a time, the next free slot with the highest priority is suggested.
quickCapture.speechUnavailableInfo: This browser doesn't support the Web Speech API. Dictation works in Chrome/Edge (desktop, Android) or Safari (iOS 14+).
quickCapture.micDeniedWeb: Microphone access denied – please allow it in your browser.
quickCapture.micDeniedApp: Microphone access denied – please allow it in the app settings.
quickCapture.parseClarify: Please clarify briefly – then all fields are complete.
quickCapture.parseFound: Fields applied. Passenger found: {name}. Please check and save.
quickCapture.parseNewCustomer: Fields applied. Passenger “{name}” will be created as a new customer on save.
quickCapture.parseNoCustomer: Fields applied, but no passenger detected. Please enter the name below.
quickCapture.endTimeInfo: Prefilled from the appointment type's duration and can be adjusted freely.
quickCapture.noTeacherFree: No {teacher} is free at this time.
quickCapture.firstFreeSlot: First free slot on this day:
quickCapture.noFreeSlotOnDay: No free slot left on this day.
quickCapture.teacherPickerInfo: You can assign several. Only {teacher} who are free at the selected time are shown – those assigned to the appointment type first, then by priority (configurable under Users). If you are free and suitable, you are selected, otherwise the best match. If a selected {teacher} becomes unavailable, they are replaced automatically.
quickCapture.reminderInfo: You'll get a notification at the selected time. Without a date, no reminder is sent. Once the appointment is confirmed, the reminder is dropped.
quickCapture.callHintsInfo: Recent calls as suggestions: enable in settings (Android app).
quickCapture.contactInGoogleAs: Already saved in Google Contacts as “{name}”.
quickCapture.contactOnPhoneAs: Already saved on the phone as “{name}”.
quickCapture.contactVcardDownloaded: vCard downloaded — import it on your phone (organization: {organization}).
quickCapture.contactAlreadyInGoogle: Number is already saved in Google Contacts.
quickCapture.contactSavedLocally: Contact saved locally under “{organization}”, not in the Google account.
quickCapture.contactNotFoundAfterSave: Saved, but not found on the phone afterwards – please check the contacts app.
quickCapture.contactDeleteConfirmGoogle: This contact is synced with Google Contacts and will be deleted there too. Continue?
quickCapture.contactDeleteConfirm: Really remove this contact from the phone?
